items.sentence: Since [MASK], and continuing, management has assigned Complainant work outside of her medical restrictions and failed to pay her properly and/or on time; 2.
On [MASK], and other unspecified dates, her clock rings were deleted; and 3.
She was first diagnosed on [MASK], which is noted in the record by her physician as the date of the injury.
On [MASK], an offer was made to Complainant for a limited duty modified assignment to work at the Lenox Hill South Station from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Complainant signed the modified job offer on [MASK], and she began the assignment on or about July 18, 2016.
